references.text: Luke 12:40 urges readiness at all times because the Son of Man will come at a time when people do not expect Him, echoing the idea of the unpredictability of the timing of the end times mentioned in Matthew 24:36.

Revelation 3:3 warns that if one does not stay awake, Jesus will come like a thief, and they will not know what hour He will come upon them. This reflects the uncertainty about the timing of the end times expressed in Matthew 24:36.

Daniel 7:2 introduces Daniel's visions concerning the end times, which provide a foundation for the apocalyptic literature that includes Matthew 24:36, even though it does not directly mention knowledge of the timing.
1 Thessalonians 5:2 speaks of the Lord's day coming like a thief in the night, similar to the warning in Matthew 24:36 that no one knows the day or hour.
